mechanism: Both drugs can cause hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients and share potential for CNS adverse effects; ivermectin may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of primaquine substrates.
action: Monitor for hemolytic anemia signs in G6PD-deficient patients; assess G6PD status before combined use; monitor for neurotoxicity symptoms; no dose adjustment typically required in non-deficient patients.
